title: Applying the Clinician-reported Genetic testing Utility InDEx (C-GUIDE) to genome sequencing: further evidence of validity
production_reason: [E4] This validates an index of clinical utility for genome sequencing, not a health or wellbeing measurement or health-state valuation.
audit_reason: [R2] The clinician-reported C-GUIDE measurement instrument is the primary object, and the study directly tests its construct validity.

title: A Collection of Components to Design Clinical Dashboards Incorporating Patient-Reported Outcome Measures: Qualitative Study
production_reason: [E4] The research develops clinical-dashboard design components; PROMs are incorporated data, not the measurement research object.
audit_reason: [RU] The study develops a framework for PROM dashboard design, but the abstract leaves uncertainty about whether this is health-measurement implementation research.
